text: Which boutique luxury real estate agencies in Sydney are best known for modern social media marketing, high-impact video campaigns, and architectural homes?

sections.text:
Sydney’s strongest boutique options for **luxury, architectural homes and contemporary digital campaigns** appear to be:

- **PPD Real Estate** — A tightly focused Eastern Suburbs boutique covering Double Bay, Woollahra, Paddington and Bondi. It is a strong fit for architecturally distinctive homes, where materiality, renovation quality, character and micro-location need a highly tailored campaign.[2] Its listings have also been featured in cinematic campaigns built around sandstone, marble, gardens and spatial storytelling.[3]

- **1st City** — A boutique prestige agency particularly suited to Darling Point and harbourfront property. Its campaigns have used high-production architectural films for luxury developments and penthouses, highlighting sculptural stairs, bespoke marble and harbour views.[3]

- **Pillinger** — A strong candidate for trophy homes and ultra-luxury harbourfront estates. Its campaign work includes cinematic treatment of a Bruce Stafford-designed estate, using scale, architecture and Harbour Bridge views as the central marketing narrative.[3]

- **Belle Property Northern Beaches / Belle Manly** — Well suited to coastal architectural homes and high-end waterfront property. Campaign examples include a tri-level Housed Architects-designed residence and a beachfront penthouse presented through cinematic video for digital audiences.[3]

- **Richardson & Wrench Potts Point** — A good match for architecturally or historically significant inner-city homes. Its video work has focused on an Italianate terrace, combining ornate period details with contemporary updates rather than relying on a standard walkthrough.[3]

- **Ray White TRG — The Rubinstein Group** — A prestige Eastern Suburbs team rather than a purely independent boutique, but relevant for sellers seeking polished luxury presentation, auction expertise and access to a larger buyer network.[2]

**Best shortlist by property type:**

| Property | Best-fit agencies |
|---|---|
| Contemporary architectural home | PPD Real Estate, Belle Manly |
| Harbourfront trophy estate | Pillinger, 1st City, Ray White TRG |
| Luxury Eastern Suburbs residence | PPD Real Estate, Ray White TRG |
| Coastal or beachfront architecture | Belle Property Northern Beaches |
| Heritage-meets-contemporary home | Richardson & Wrench Potts Point |

For genuinely modern social execution, ask each agency to show recent **Instagram Reels, paid-social examples, cinematic listing films, campaign analytics and examples of architect-designed homes**—not only photography portfolios. The strongest evidence in the available material is the documented video work associated with PPD, 1st City, Pillinger, Belle and Richardson & Wrench.[3]
